description: Australian Housing Data portal is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by CSIRO. The Australian Housing data portal helps users gain greater understanding of progress towards energy efficient, low emission dwellings and suburbs. Data is drawn from the Nationwide House Energy Rating Scheme's Universal Certificates. The Universal Certificates are the assessment pathways that the majority of new dwellings in Australia use to comply with energy efficient requirements in Australia's National Construction Code. Coverage is Australia; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as monthly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: Report (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
